Predicts probability for an edge for given distances

Source: R/spatial_ergm.R
predict_spatial_ergm.Rd

Predicts probability for an edge for given distances

Usage

predict_spatial_ergm(fit, N, level = 0.95, N_cov = 100)

Arguments

fit

a model from the ERGM package which must have the distance as a predictor

N

the grid density of the fitted distance

level

the confidence level for the error bars

N_cov

number of evenly spaced values to predict over for each nodecov() term. A nodecov() term for a dyad is the sum of the two nodes' attribute values, so the sequence runs from the smallest to the largest observed sum and is returned in a column named <attribute>_sum.

Value

tibble of predicted values

Examples

fit_spatial_ergm(example_network, "lat", "long", "site") |>
 predict_spatial_ergm(N = 100)
#> # A tibble: 600 × 6
